Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-alert-code-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-alert-code-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
contraindication ContraindicationA clinical contraindication relevant to a planned intervention, medication, immunization, or procedure.
allergy-risk Allergy riskA known or suspected allergy or intolerance risk requiring attention.
medication-interaction Medication interactionA possible clinically significant interaction involving one or more medications.
duplicate-therapy Duplicate therapyPotentially duplicative medication or treatment has been identified.
missed-dose Missed doseA scheduled medication or immunization dose was not administered as expected.
dose-due Dose dueA scheduled medication or immunization dose is currently due.
dose-overdue Dose overdueA scheduled medication or immunization dose is overdue.
abnormal-result Abnormal resultA clinical or diagnostic result is outside its expected or acceptable range.
critical-result Critical resultA critical clinical or diagnostic result requires urgent review or action.
pending-result Pending resultA clinically relevant diagnostic result is still pending.
infection-risk Infection riskAn infection, exposure, or transmission risk requires attention or precautions.
isolation-required Isolation requiredThe subject requires isolation or specific infection-prevention precautions.
safeguarding-concern Safeguarding concernA safeguarding concern requires review or protective action.
possible-duplicate-record Possible duplicate recordThe subject may have more than one health record.
identity-mismatch Identity mismatchDemographic, biometric, or identifier information may not match the intended subject.
data-quality-issue Data quality issueA data-quality, completeness, consistency, or record-integrity issue requires review.
consent-restriction Consent restrictionA consent directive limits access, disclosure, or use of the subject's information.
follow-up-required Follow-up requiredThe subject requires clinical, public-health, or administrative follow-up.
referral-required Referral requiredReferral to another provider, facility, service, or level of care is required.
reporting-required Reporting requiredA statutory, programmatic, or public-health report or notification must be submitted.
urgent-review Urgent reviewThe subject's information or clinical status requires urgent review.
other OtherAn alert type not represented by another code in this code system.

title: Nigeria Alert Code System
description: Common alert types used by Nigerian health information systems and represented using the Nigeria Alert Flag profile.
